events.info: Join BFA in Dance Seniors as they share their Fall BFA Senior Projects. Each work represents the students' choreographic vision. Our annual holiday concert features the USF Chamber Singers, the JGHC Honors Choir, and the debut Choral Union, USF?s new university-community chorus.
